title: 第19章 双倍灵石杀妖兽第20章 大收获
content_zh:
第19章双倍灵石！
杀妖兽
见他不停跪地磕头，姜胜连忙上前扶起道：“袁师弟，你我同住一屋，不必客气。”
“姜师兄，你借给我的灵石，我一定会双倍还你。”
袁昌语气感激，他当场取出纸笔，当着屋子内所有人写下欠条，道：“姜师兄，这欠条你收好。”
“嗯，好。”
姜胜笑着点了点头，把欠条收下，毕竟亲兄弟明算账，他的灵石也不富裕。
“诸位师兄师弟，我已经有三颗下品灵石，只差三颗下品灵石，我必定能突破到炼气三重，成为外门弟子。”
写完欠条，袁昌目光又看向木屋内其他八人道：“只要谁肯借我灵石，我发誓一定双倍还灵石。”
有了姜胜带头，另一名叫吴峰的炼气二重杂役弟子，他距离当满三年杂役弟子，还有一年时间，就算缓些时日，吸收灵石也可以。
他念在与袁昌这一年多同吃同住，经常结伴去灵气充裕的洞府修炼的情谊，他犹豫了一下，取出一颗灵石递了过去，道：“袁师兄，我的灵石借给你一颗吧！”
“谢谢吴师兄。”
袁昌一脸感激的接过灵石，然后写下欠条。
他现在已经有四颗灵石，距离突破到炼气三重，所需的灵石只差一点。
屋内，林浩目光落在袁昌身上，心中思索起来，有欠条在，也不怕袁昌不还，否则可以找宗门执事主持公道。
现在借出灵石，袁昌承诺还双倍灵石，就像是一场风险投资，赌的是袁昌能成为外门弟子。
“袁师兄，我身上的两颗灵石也借给你吧！”
林浩觉得投资炼气二重后期的袁昌，成功率还是蛮高的，再加上袁昌平时为人不错，对他颇有照顾，他来玄岳宗才一年时间，距离成为外门弟子的期限，还有两年时间，晚一点吸收灵石，也没什么关系。
如果后面袁昌成为外门弟子，按照他说的双倍偿还，借两颗灵石，还给他四颗。
林浩再靠着万古长生塔无损耗吸收灵石灵气的能力，他就相当于别人吸收八颗灵石的灵气规模。

“林师弟，谢谢。”
袁昌不禁眼睛一热，真是患难见真情。
有了林浩借他的两颗灵石，便筹足突破所需的六颗灵石，他突破到炼气三重成为外门弟子，至少有九成以上机率。
“袁师兄不必客气，拿着吧！”
林浩决定投资袁昌，很有气魄的把刚领取的灵石递了过去。
“诸位大恩大德，我袁昌必有厚报。”
接过两颗灵石，袁昌激动极了语气诚恳，他直接跪在地上，又对着三人用力的磕了几个头。
今日借灵石之恩，无异于把他快要断掉的仙路，重新续接上了。
屋内，其他六名炼气一重的杂役弟子，不像林浩他们和袁昌，经常一起结伴前往灵气浓郁的山洞修炼，有很好的交情，见袁昌借够了灵石，不再向他们借取，都不由暗暗松了一大口气。
寒冬，大雪持续不断，有些难熬。
但好在时间过得很快，转眼一个多月过去。
天气开始转暖，冰雪消融，春日已近。
袁昌靠着林浩他们借给他的灵石，终于在距离他满三年的最后九天时间，突破到了炼气三重，他只需在玄岳宗登记一下身份，便可成为一名光荣的外门弟子。
一旦成为外门弟子，就可以在玄岳宗停留六年，如果在六年内，没有成为内门弟子，才会被玄岳宗派到世俗中处理门派事务。
并且，以外门弟子的身份去世俗中，可比杂役弟子到世俗的待遇和地位高太多了。
第19章双倍灵石！
杀妖兽
袁昌拥有外门弟子身份，以后每月可以领取两枚下品灵石，要是再接取一些外门弟子任务，他还能额外赚取灵石。
按照他之前承诺还两倍灵石，差不多只需四个月时间，他就能还完欠林浩他们的八颗灵石。
content_en:
Chapter 19 Double spiritual stones!
Kill monsters
Seeing him kneeling and kowtowing, Jiang Sheng quickly stepped forward to help him up and said, "Junior Brother Yuan, you and I live in the same room, so there's no need to be polite."
"Senior Brother Jiang, I will definitely return double the amount of the spirit stone you lent me."
Yuan Chang sounded grateful. He took out a pen and paper on the spot, wrote down the IOU in front of everyone in the room, and said, "Senior Brother Jiang, please keep this IOU."
"Yeah, okay."
Jiang Sheng nodded with a smile and accepted the IOU. After all, his brother Ming settled the accounts and his spiritual stones were not rich.
"Brothers and sisters, I already have three low-grade spiritual stones. I only need three low-grade spiritual stones. I will definitely be able to break through to the third level of Qi refining and become an outer disciple."
After writing the IOU, Yuan Chang looked at the other eight people in the wooden house and said: "As long as anyone is willing to lend me the spirit stone, I swear that I will return the spirit stone double."
With Jiang Sheng taking the lead, there is another second-level Qi Refining handyman disciple named Wu Feng. He still has one year left before he can become a handyman disciple for three years. Even if he takes a little longer to absorb the spirit stones, he can do it.
He thought about the friendship he had shared with Yuan Chang for more than a year, sharing meals and living together, and often going to the cave with abundant spiritual energy to practice together. He hesitated for a moment, took out a spiritual stone and handed it over, saying: "Senior Brother Yuan, please lend you one of my spiritual stones!"
"Thank you, Senior Brother Wu."
Yuan Chang took the spirit stone with a grateful expression, and then wrote an IOU.
He now has four spiritual stones, which are just a little short of the spiritual stones needed to break through to the third level of Qi refining.
In the room, Lin Hao's eyes fell on Yuan Chang, and he thought about it. There was an IOU, and he was not afraid that Yuan Chang would not pay it back, otherwise he could ask the sect's deacon to seek justice.
Now that the spirit stones are being lent, Yuan Chang promises to return double the spirit stones. It is like a venture capital investment, betting that Yuan Chang can become an outer disciple.
"Senior Brother Yuan, please lend me the two spiritual stones I have on you!"
Lin Hao felt that the success rate of investing in Yuan Chang, who was in the late second level of Qi Refining, was quite high. In addition, Yuan Chang was usually a good person and took good care of him. He had only been in Xuanyue Sect for a year, and there were still two years left before he could become an outer disciple. It would not matter if he absorbed the spirit stone later.
If Yuan Chang becomes an outer disciple later, he will repay double the amount he promised, borrow two spiritual stones and give him four back.
If Lin Hao relied on the Eternal Eternal Life Tower's ability to absorb the spiritual energy of spiritual stones without any loss, he would be equivalent to someone else absorbing the spiritual energy of eight spiritual stones.
"Junior brother Lin, thank you."
Yuan Chang couldn't help but feel his eyes heat up, it was true that a friend in need was a friend indeed.
With the two spirit stones that Lin Hao borrowed from him, he had collected the six spirit stones needed for a breakthrough. There was at least a 90% chance that he would break through to the third level of Qi Refining and become an outer sect disciple.
"Senior Brother Yuan, you're welcome, just take it!"
Lin Hao decided to invest in Yuan Chang and handed over the spiritual stone he had just received with great courage.
"I, Yuan Chang, will definitely repay you for your great kindness."
After receiving the two spirit stones, Yuan Chang was so excited that he spoke sincerely. He knelt directly on the ground and kowtowed vigorously to the three of them.
Borrowing the help of the spiritual stone today is like reconnecting his immortal path that was about to be cut off.
In the room, the other six handyman disciples of the first level of Qi refining, unlike Lin Hao and Yuan Chang, often went to the caves with rich spiritual energy to practice together, and they had a good friendship. Seeing that Yuan Chang had borrowed enough spiritual stones and no longer borrowed them from them, they couldn't help but secretly heaved a sigh of relief.
The cold winter, with constant heavy snowfall, is a bit difficult.
But fortunately, time flies by quickly, and more than a month has passed in the blink of an eye.
The weather is getting warmer, the ice and snow are melting, and spring is approaching.
Relying on the spiritual stones lent to him by Lin Hao and others, Yuan Chang finally broke through to the third level of Qi refining in the last nine days of his three years. He only needed to register his identity with the Xuanyue Sect to become a glorious outer disciple.
Once you become an outer disciple, you can stay in the Xuanyue Sect for six years. If you do not become an inner disciple within six years, you will be sent by the Xuanyue Sect to handle sect affairs in the secular world.
and, besidesThe status of a disciple in the secular world is much higher than the treatment and status of a handyman disciple in the secular world.
Chapter 19 Double spiritual stones!
Kill monsters
Yuan Chang has the status of an outer disciple and can receive two low-grade spiritual stones every month from now on. If he takes on some more outer disciple tasks, he can earn additional spiritual stones.
According to his previous promise to repay twice the spiritual stones, it would only take about four months for him to repay the eight spiritual stones he owed Lin Hao and the others.
